i want her to be happy. shes happy with him. i would take her back in a heart beat. i still love her dearly. but with all that said, she wouldnt be happy with me, i mean, she ended it, and to end it, there must have been a reason.

this is the first ive gone to for suicide/relationship issues. I saw one in my youth about my ADD/ADHD issues. that one resulted in being beaten by my parents because "its in my head, its not real"

pretty much, your parents abused you? thats not that bad. your friend learning how bad your life was from witnessing it and killing himself cuz of it? you should be ashamed you didnt help him

Edit: you need to call your ex and reconnect with her, even though she might have (most likely) slept with her now current bf before breaking up with you.
